Name: Sir Robert's Flower Catalog
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Description[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]This collection contains all of the flowers from my previously published mods into one large catalog. With this all-in-one mod, you will have a much easier time finding the perfect flowers of your decorating dreams for your home in Stardew Valley. All of the images will automatically appear in the Decor Section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]If you are like me and want as many flowers as possible in a well-organized format, please download Sir Robert's Flower Catalog and delete my other mods. (Remember to remove any of my old flowers first from your game; otherwise you'll get those pesky red error symbols on your screen).[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Please note: my other mods are still available if you prefer to have a smaller amount of plants and flowers.  [/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Installation instructions[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Main features[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]This mod features 110 images; each one has a variety of colors, vases and pots to choose from via Alternative Textures. Some images only have a few Alternative Textures and others may have 20 or more. I feel that I've successfully paired each flower with the perfect vase or pot and hope they bring you happiness as you play the game.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]They will all fit perfectly centered upon most end tables. Due to the large amount of images, I didn't include any that fit upon kitchen counters.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Requirements[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Requires the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I recommend using Happy Home Designer. Also, I suggest using Precise Furniture to move any of the large flower pots on the floor. This way you can move them pixel-by-pixel and it will make decorating a lot easier.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4][u][b]Shout outs[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]The end tables in the pictures are from mods made by Platinum Cats, lululovely and HimeTarts & Wildflour. I also used end tables from the Stardew Valley furniture catalog.[/size][/color]
